---
title: "htopo"
subtitle: "Hi-resolution geometry hub of a domain"
---

## Overview

`htopo` is the reference geometry of a domain in a multigrid setup (e.g.
yelmox). Its grid is the finest in the setup, and a coupler remaps *from*
it when a coarser module needs the topography or the masks. It holds:

- `ref` ([topodata](topodata.qmd)): the reference `z_bed`, `H_ice`, `z_srf`
  and `z_bed_sd` of a FesmData topography product (`z_bed_sd` is 0 if not
  loaded);
- `reg` ([regions](regions.qmd)): regions, zones, basins and the named
  masks of the regions namelist group;
- `mask_ice`: where ice is dynamic, fixed (prescribed) or not allowed
  (`htopo_ice_dynamic` = 2, `htopo_ice_fixed` = 1, `htopo_ice_none` = 0, the
  values of Yelmo's `MASK_ICE_*`);
- `tau_relax`: the relaxation timescale toward the reference, -1 (free)
  where no relaxation is selected;
- `z_bed`, `H_ice`, `z_srf`, `f_grnd`, `z_sl`: the current geometry,
  refreshed from the models. `htopo_update` sets it on a hub finer than the
  ice sheet: the reference plus the models' anomalies, with `f_grnd` 0 or 1
  from flotation.

Gaps of the reference geometry (e.g. outside the coverage of the files) are
filled at init: no ice, the bed from the nearest valid cell, the surface
from flotation at sea level 0.

## Public API

| Procedure | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `htopo_init(htopo, filename, group, group_topo, group_regions, domain, grid_name, cnst, map_fldr)` | Load the hub on grid `grid_name` (`<map_fldr>/grid_<name>.txt`, default `maps`) |
| `htopo_update(htopo, dz_bed, dH_ice, z_sl)` | Current geometry from the reference and anomalies |
| `htopo_basins(htopo)` | Basin ids of the basin set `basins` (0 everywhere without one) |
| `htopo_write_init(htopo, filename, time_init)` | Output file with the static masks |
| `htopo_write_step(htopo, filename, time)` | Append the current geometry |

## Namelist configuration

Three groups; a domain of a multi-domain setup passes its own (e.g.
`domain_south`, `topo_south`, `regions_south`).

```
&domain
    mask_ice_dynamic = "region:Greenland,Canadian_Arctic_Archipelago | zone:open_ocean"  ! default "all"
    mask_ice_fixed   = "none"            ! default; over mask_ice_dynamic
    relax            = "none"            ! default; where ice relaxes to the reference
    relax_tau        = 0.0               ! [yr] needed > 0 with relax
    basins           = "Zwally2012"      ! basin set of htopo_basins (default "": none)
/
&topo
    path  = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_TOPO-BedMachine-v6.nc"
    vars  = "z_bed" "z_srf" "H_ice" "z_bed_sd"
/
&regions
    path_regions = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_REGIONS.nc"
    path_basins  = "ice_data/v2/{domain}/{grid_name}/{grid_name}_BASINS-{set}.nc"
    basin_sets   = "Zwally2012"
/
```

The masks are selection expressions of [regions](regions.qmd). Everything
outside `mask_ice_dynamic` and `mask_ice_fixed` has no ice.
